stages.title: Stage 1 - Number of Islands
stages.statement: Count the total number of connected islands.

stages.title: Stage 2 - Max Area of Island
stages.statement: Find the maximum area of a single island.

stages.title: Stage 3 - Island Perimeter
stages.statement: Calculate the total perimeter of all land masses.

stages.title: Stage 4 - Closed Islands
stages.statement: Count the number of islands completely surrounded by water (not touching the border).

stages.title: Stage 5 - Shortest Bridge
stages.statement: Given exactly two distinct islands, find the minimum number of 0s you must flip to connect them.

problem.title: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock (Code War Chain)

stages.title: Stage 1 - Single Transaction
stages.statement: Find the maximum profit you can achieve with **exactly one** transaction (buy once and sell once). Ignore `F` and `K`.

stages.title: Stage 2 - Infinite Transactions
stages.statement: Find the maximum profit you can achieve with **unlimited** transactions (buy and sell as many times as you want, but you must sell before you buy again). Ignore `F` and `K`.

stages.title: Stage 3 - Transaction Fee
stages.statement: Find the maximum profit with **unlimited** transactions, but you must pay a transaction fee `F` for every completed trade (buy + sell). Ignore `K`.

stages.title: Stage 4 - Cooldown Period
stages.statement: Find the maximum profit with **unlimited** transactions, but after you sell your stock, you cannot buy stock on the next day (i.e., a 1-day cooldown period). Ignore `F` and `K`.

stages.title: Stage 5 - At Most 2 Transactions
stages.statement: Find the maximum profit you can achieve with **at most two** transactions. Ignore `F` and `K`.

stages.title: Stage 6 - At Most K Transactions
stages.statement: Find the maximum profit you can achieve with **at most K** transactions. Ignore `F`.
